strings.corner_timer: Show a small timer in the screen corner
strings.hint_close: Closing this window keeps the app running in the background.
strings.error_autostart: Could not change the startup setting.
strings.share_data: Share anonymous usage data with the developers
strings.share_info: If you switch this on, once a day Breyek sends: the app version, language, theme, how many breaks you took and how many minutes you used the computer. Keys, text, screen images and files are never sent. We use this data to improve Breyek and to show you ads. Switch it off at any time: then nothing leaves your computer and the collected data is deleted.
strings.share_local: In this version the data stays on your computer: the developers' server is not connected yet.
strings.share_today: Collected today: {breaks} breaks, {minutes} min of use.
strings.sponsors_thanks: Thank you to everyone who supports Breyek.
strings.sponsor_line: {name} – thank you for your support and help.
strings.sponsors_join: Want to support Breyek? Contact the developers.
strings.pause_media: Pause videos and music during the break
strings.stats_note: Approximate: worked out only from whether you type, use the mouse or the screen moves. Stored on this computer; only the totals are shared, and only if you turned on data sharing.
strings.privacy_contact: Questions about your data? Write to {email}
strings.share_activity: It also sends how many minutes a day you spent typing, using the mouse, in full screen, watching videos and reading: only these totals, never what you typed or saw.
strings.consent_text: Breyek runs on your computer. To time your breaks it only checks when you type, use the mouse or the screen changes – never what you type or see. To use Breyek, please read and agree to the privacy policy and terms of use.
strings.consent_read: Read the privacy policy and terms of use
strings.consent_note: Optional. You can change this at any time in the Privacy tab.

strings.pro_free: You are using the free version.

strings.pro_pitch: Pro adds your own timers, smart pause during calls and full-screen apps, snoozing, a 30-day view with CSV export, an evening filter schedule, extra themes, sounds and guided eye exercises – and no sponsors during breaks.

strings.snooze: Warn 30 s before a break and let me snooze it
strings.break_held: Break waits: call or full-screen app
strings.filter_auto: Turn the eye filter on automatically
strings.ex_dot: Follow the dot with your eyes. Keep your head still.
strings.ex_far: Look at something at least 6 metres away.
strings.ex_palm: Close your eyes and cover them with your palms.
strings.ex_neck: Roll your shoulders and gently stretch your neck.

tips: Look at something at least 6 m (20 ft) away.
Slowly roll your eyes in a circle - 5 times each way.
Blink slowly and fully 10 times to rewet your eyes.
Stand up and walk around a bit.
Go outside for a minute - natural light and distance are great for your eyes.
Cover your eyes with warm palms for 20 seconds (palming).
Look out of a window and focus on the farthest object you can see.
Stretch your neck and shoulders, then drink some water.
Focus on your thumb at arm's length, then on something far away. Repeat 5 times.
